datasets.name: ds_audit
queryLines:
WITH
-- budget columns: per-user AI Gateway budget for each identity (billing run_as).
-- Budget tables are read at the snapshot of the budget job's latest run. If that run didn't
-- succeed (or never ran) the budget columns show an 'N/A: ...' placeholder instead.
bud_status AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(status, run_time) AS status, MAX_BY(snapshot_time, run_time) AS ts
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_job_status
),
bud_ts AS (SELECT ts FROM bud_status),
bud_per_user AS (
  SELECT l.budget_id, s.display_name AS budget_name, l.default_threshold
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_limit l
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_snapshot s ON s.budget_id = l.budget_id AND s.snapshot_time = l.snapshot_time
  WHERE l.scope_type = 'ALERT_CONFIGURATION_SCOPE_TYPE_PER_USER'
    AND l.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_ws AS (
  SELECT budget_id, workspace_id FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_workspace WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag AS (
  SELECT budget_id, tag_key, tag_value FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_tag WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag_keys AS (SELECT budget_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_key) AS n_keys FROM bud_tag GROUP BY budget_id),
bud_ids AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, run_as, tags_json, from_json(tags_json, 'map<string,string>') AS tags
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as, to_json(custom_tags) AS tags_json
    FROM system.billing.usage
    WHERE billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90)
      AND identity_metadata.run_as IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  )
),
bud_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT budget_id, run_as FROM (
    SELECT p.budget_id, i.run_as, COALESCE(k.n_keys, 0) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tag_key) AS n_matched
    FROM bud_per_user p
    CROSS JOIN bud_ids i
    LEFT JOIN bud_ws w ON w.budget_id = p.budget_id AND w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT budget_id FROM bud_ws) hw ON hw.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag_keys k ON k.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag t ON t.budget_id = p.budget_id AND try_element_at(i.tags, t.tag_key) = t.tag_value
    WHERE w.budget_id IS NOT NULL OR hw.budget_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.budget_id, i.run_as, i.workspace_id, i.tags_json, k.n_keys
  )
  WHERE n_matched = n_keys
),
bud_principal AS (
  SELECT principal_id, principal_type, run_as FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_principal WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_override AS (
  SELECT budget_id, principal_id, override_threshold FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_override WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_user_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, p.run_as, o.override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o JOIN bud_principal p ON p.principal_id = o.principal_id AND p.principal_type <> 'GROUP'
),
bud_group_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, m.run_as, MAX(o.override_threshold) AS override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_group_member g ON g.group_id = o.principal_id AND g.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
  JOIN bud_principal m ON m.principal_id = g.member_principal_id
  GROUP BY o.budget_id, m.run_as
),
user_budget AS (
  SELECT run_as, budget_name, budget_limit_usd, budget_limit_source FROM (
    SELECT s.run_as, p.budget_name,
      -- Within a budget the most permissive override wins (own or any group's); any override
      -- replaces the default. GREATEST skips NULLs. Across budgets the tightest limit wins.
      COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold) AS budget_limit_usd,
      CASE WHEN uo.override_threshold IS NULL AND gov.override_threshold IS NULL THEN 'Budget default'
           WHEN gov.override_threshold IS NULL OR uo.override_threshold >= gov.override_threshold THEN 'Own override'
           ELSE 'Group override' END AS budget_limit_source,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.run_as
        ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold), p.budget_name) AS rn
    FROM bud_scope s
    JOIN bud_per_user p ON p.budget_id = s.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_user_ovr uo ON uo.budget_id = s.budget_id AND uo.run_as = s.run_as
    LEFT JOIN bud_group_ovr gov ON gov.budget_id = s.budget_id AND gov.run_as = s.run_as
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
_base AS (
-- Dataset: ds_audit — prod workhorse, one row per Genie API call.
-- Source: system.access.audit (service_name='aibiGenie'). Deployable in any
-- workspace with the system.access schema enabled.
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.workspace_id,
    a.event_id,
    a.event_time,
    a.event_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('minute', a.event_time)            AS event_time_minute,
    a.user_identity.email                         AS user_name,
    a.action_name,
    a.request_params.space_id                     AS genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, a.request_params.space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    -- Application the space belongs to, from the bound SQL WAREHOUSE's
    -- 'application' tag (NOT Genie Space metadata). NULL if the warehouse is untagged.
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    -- Workspace attributes all come from the workspace mapping table (workspace_summary), so
    -- the Workspace / __BU_LABEL__ / __ENV_LABEL__ filters agree. Workspaces missing from it, or with
    -- blank attributes, show as '(unmapped: <id>)' / '(unmapped)' instead of being dropped when a
    -- filter is applied. Every dataset uses the same expressions so filter values line up.
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')                 AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)')        AS environment,
    ws.status                                     AS workspace_status,
    a.request_params.conversation_id              AS conversation_id,
    a.request_params.message_id                   AS message_id,
    a.request_params.feedback_rating              AS feedback_rating,
    a.response.status_code                        AS response_status_code,
    a.response.error_message                      AS response_error_message,
    CASE WHEN a.action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_message_create,
    CASE WHEN a.action_name IN ('genieSendMessageFeedback','updateConversationMessageFeedback') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_feedback,
    CASE WHEN a.response.status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_success,
    CASE WHEN a.request_params.feedback_rating = 'THUMBS_UP'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_thumbs_up,
    CASE WHEN a.request_params.feedback_rating = 'THUMBS_DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_thumbs_down,
    -- Precomputed message-create success / error flags (so Lakeview COUNTER
    -- widgets can SUM a single column — Lakeview drops multi-aggregate /
    -- division expressions in counters).
    CASE WHEN a.action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage') AND a.response.status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_msg_create_success,
    CASE WHEN a.action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage') AND a.response.status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_msg_create_error
FROM system.access.audit a
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = a.request_params.space_id
-- Customer workspace-mapping table (workspace_id is LONG; unique per workspace
-- so no fan-out). Single source for workspace_name / bu / environment / status.
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(a.workspace_id AS BIGINT)
WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie'
  AND a.event_date >= :date_range.min
  AND a.event_date <= :date_range.max
)
SELECT _base.*,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN COALESCE(ub.budget_name, 'No per-user budget')
       WHEN bs.status = 'NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN 'N/A: budgets not set up'
       WHEN bs.status IS NULL THEN 'N/A: budget job has not run'
       ELSE 'N/A: budget job failed' END AS budget_name,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_usd END AS budget_limit_usd,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_source END AS budget_limit_source
FROM _base CROSS JOIN bud_status bs LEFT JOIN user_budget ub ON ub.run_as = _base.`user_name`

datasets.name: ds_latency
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_latency — per-message end-to-end latency (seconds), via the
-- polling-event self-join.
--
-- A1 methodology (deliberate): percentiles are computed over
-- `latency_sec_capped`, which is NULL when the poll-span exceeds 600s.
-- APPROX_PERCENTILE ignores NULLs, so messages that ran >600s (long-running or
-- stuck/abandoned — ~8-9% of traffic, up to many hours) are EXCLUDED from
-- p50/p95/p99 rather than pegging them at the old 600s cap. Those cases are
-- surfaced separately via `is_longrunning` (a long-running / non-response rate).
-- NOTE: this is a polling-span proxy for latency (first→last poll), not a
-- directly-measured server duration; system tables expose no direct Genie
-- duration field today.
--
-- workspace_id is in the per-message grain, so the Workspace / BU / Environment
-- filters apply via a mapping join with NULL-capture ('(unmapped: <id>)').
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
      event_time, workspace_id,
      user_identity.email            AS user_name,
      request_params.space_id        AS genie_space_id,
      request_params.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
      request_params.message_id      AS message_id,
      response.status_code           AS status_code,
      action_name
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND action_name IN (
      'genieGetConversationMessage','genieGetMessageQueryResult',
      'genieGetMessageAttachmentQueryResult','getConversationMessage',
      'getMessageAttachmentQueryResult'
    )
),
polling AS (
  SELECT genie_space_id, conversation_id, message_id, workspace_id, user_name,
         MIN(event_time) AS first_poll_ts,
         MAX(event_time) AS last_poll_ts,
         MAX_BY(status_code, event_time) AS final_status_code,
         COUNT(*) AS poll_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
)
SELECT
    p.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(p.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    p.genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, p.genie_space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    p.conversation_id, p.message_id, p.user_name,
    p.first_poll_ts, p.last_poll_ts AS finished_at_time, p.poll_count, p.final_status_code,
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.last_poll_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.first_poll_ts) AS latency_sec,
    -- percentiles are taken over this column; NULL (excluded) when > 600s
    CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.last_poll_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.first_poll_ts) <= 600
         THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.last_poll_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.first_poll_ts) END AS latency_sec_capped,
    -- 1 when the message ran >600s (long-running / stuck / non-response)
    CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.last_poll_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(p.first_poll_ts) > 600
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_longrunning
FROM polling p
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = p.genie_space_id
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(p.workspace_id AS BIGINT)

datasets.name: ds_qpm
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_qpm — queries-per-minute per (workspace, space, minute) from
-- message-create events. Drives Peak QPM, the QPM heatmap, and the QPM
-- time series.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
      workspace_id,
      request_params.space_id          AS genie_space_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('minute', event_time) AS event_time_minute,
      HOUR(event_time)                 AS hod,
      DATE_FORMAT(event_time, 'EEE')   AS dow_label,
      COUNT(*)                         AS queries_in_minute
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage')
    AND request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
)
SELECT
    b.workspace_id,
    -- workspace_name / bu / environment from the customer workspace-mapping
    -- table (same single source as ds_audit). NULL-capture so any workspace
    -- absent from the mapping surfaces as '(unmapped: <id>)' instead of dropping
    -- out when a filter is applied.
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(b.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    b.genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, b.genie_space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    b.event_time_minute,
    b.hod,
    b.dow_label,
    b.queries_in_minute
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = b.genie_space_id
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(b.workspace_id AS BIGINT)

datasets.name: ds_users
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_users — one row per (user, day, workspace, space). Drives
-- WAU/MAU, active-user counters, and the productivity (msgs/user/day) trend.
--
-- genie_space_id is carried into the grain so the tab-level Genie Space /
-- SQL Warehouse filters apply here too (a user active in N spaces contributes
-- one row per space). This is safe for every visual built on this dataset:
--   - COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) still dedupes across the per-space rows, so
--     active-user counts are unchanged when NO space filter is applied, and
--     become "distinct users of the selected space" when one is.
--   - SUM(messages_sent) decomposes cleanly across spaces (sums to the same
--     total unfiltered; to the per-space total when filtered).
-- Events with no space_id (rare non-space Genie calls) surface as '(no space)'
-- so those users still count as active.
--
-- Original per-(user,day) aggregate preserved as CTE `base`; mapping joins add
-- genie_space_name / sql_warehouse_name (from dim_genie_space) and
-- workspace_name / bu / environment, all with NULL-capture so nothing is dropped
-- when a filter is applied.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
      user_identity.email     AS user_name,
      workspace_id,
      event_date,
      request_params.space_id AS genie_space_id,
      SUM(CASE WHEN action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS messages_sent
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND user_identity.email IS NOT NULL
    AND user_identity.email <> 'System-User'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT
    b.user_name,
    b.workspace_id,
    b.event_date,
    b.genie_space_id,
    b.messages_sent,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, b.genie_space_id, '(no space)') AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)')        AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)')              AS warehouse_application,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(b.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = b.genie_space_id
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(b.workspace_id AS BIGINT)

datasets.name: ds_msgs_per_user
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_msgs_per_user — per-(user, workspace) total messages across the
-- window, with a bucket label. Pre-aggregated so the distribution bar counts
-- users per bucket (avoids per-row grain mismatch).
--
-- workspace_id is in the per-user aggregation grain so the Workspace / BU /
-- Environment filters re-bucket a user by their activity WITHIN the selected
-- workspace(s). A user active in >1 workspace therefore contributes one row per
-- workspace. Mapping join uses NULL-capture: any workspace absent from the
-- mapping table surfaces as '(unmapped: <workspace_id>)' rather than dropping
-- out when a filter is applied.
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_identity.email AS user_name,
         workspace_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS user_total_messages
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND user_identity.email IS NOT NULL
    AND user_identity.email <> 'System-User'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    p.user_name,
    p.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(p.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    p.user_total_messages,
    CASE
      WHEN p.user_total_messages >= 100 THEN '100+'
      WHEN p.user_total_messages >= 50  THEN '50-99'
      WHEN p.user_total_messages >= 10  THEN '10-49'
      ELSE '1-9'
    END AS msg_bucket
FROM per_user p
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(p.workspace_id AS BIGINT)
WHERE p.user_total_messages > 0

datasets.name: ds_thumbs_per_space
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_thumbs_per_space — per-(space, workspace) thumbs feedback: up
-- count, down count, total reactions, and thumbs-up ratio (precomputed DOUBLE).
--
-- The noise floor is now a DASHBOARD PARAMETER (:min_reactions, default 1) driven
-- by a "Minimum reactions" input above the visual, instead of a hardcoded >=5 —
-- so the user chooses how many reactions a space needs before it shows.
--
-- workspace_id is carried into the aggregation grain (a space is NOT 1:1 with a
-- workspace) so the Workspace / BU / Environment filters apply. The mapping
-- join uses NULL-capture: any workspace absent from the mapping table surfaces
-- as '(unmapped: <workspace_id>)' rather than being dropped by the filter.
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
      request_params.space_id AS genie_space_id,
      workspace_id,
      SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating='THUMBS_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS thumbs_up,
      SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating='THUMBS_DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thumbs_down,
      SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP','THUMBS_DOWN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_reactions,
      CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating='THUMBS_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP','THUMBS_DOWN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thumbs_ratio_dbl
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND action_name IN ('genieSendMessageFeedback','updateConversationMessageFeedback')
    AND request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL
    AND request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP','THUMBS_DOWN')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP','THUMBS_DOWN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= :min_reactions
)
SELECT
    a.genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, a.genie_space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    a.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    a.thumbs_up,
    a.thumbs_down,
    a.total_reactions,
    a.thumbs_ratio_dbl
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = a.genie_space_id
LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON ws.workspace_id = CAST(a.workspace_id AS BIGINT)

datasets.name: ds_errors_by_type
queryLines:
-- Dataset: ds_errors_by_type — per-(space, workspace, error_class) COUNT of
-- errored message-create events, for a stacked bar (one segment per error type).
--
-- Counts ALL error responses (status_code >= 400), broken out by class. NOTE on
-- 429: the old per-space QPM cap was removed with Genie PayGo (429s in this
-- workspace went to zero ~Jul 2026); a 429 TODAY is a different guardrail
-- (LLM-capacity / workspace-concurrency / token-budget), so it is genuinely worth
-- showing as its own class, not hidden. No message-count threshold (the old
-- HAVING >=20 hid the low-volume spaces that actually had errors).
--
-- workspace_id is in the aggregation grain, so the Workspace / BU / Environment
-- filters apply via a mapping join with NULL-capture ('(unmapped: <id>)').
WITH errs AS (
  SELECT
      request_params.space_id AS genie_space_id,
      workspace_id,
      CASE
        WHEN response.status_code = 429             THEN '429 throttling/guardrail'
        WHEN response.status_code = 403             THEN '403 forbidden'
        WHEN response.status_code = 404             THEN '404 not found'
        WHEN response.status_code >= 500            THEN '5xx server'
        WHEN response.status_code >= 400            THEN '4xx other client'
      END AS error_class
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage')
    AND request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL
    AND response.status_code >= 400
)
SELECT
    e.genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, e.genie_space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    e.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(e.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    e.error_class,
    COUNT(*) AS error_count
FROM errs e

-- Dataset: ds_conv_length — one row per conversation, with its turn count
-- (number of message-create events in that conversation). Drives the
-- "Avg messages per conversation" counter (a widget-level AVG over these rows).
--
-- workspace_id is in the per-conversation grain, so the Workspace / BU /
-- Environment filters apply via a mapping join with NULL-capture.
WITH conv AS (
  SELECT
      request_params.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
      workspace_id,
      request_params.space_id        AS genie_space_id,
      COUNT(*)                       AS turns
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    AND action_name IN ('genieCreateConversationMessage','createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','regenerateConversationMessage')
    AND request_params.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    c.conversation_id,
    c.genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, c.genie_space_id) AS genie_space_name,
    COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)') AS warehouse_application,
    c.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(c.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
    COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
    COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
    c.turns

WITH
-- budget columns: per-user AI Gateway budget for each identity (billing run_as).
-- Budget tables are read at the snapshot of the budget job's latest run. If that run didn't
-- succeed (or never ran) the budget columns show an 'N/A: ...' placeholder instead.
bud_status AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(status, run_time) AS status, MAX_BY(snapshot_time, run_time) AS ts
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_job_status
),
bud_ts AS (SELECT ts FROM bud_status),
bud_per_user AS (
  SELECT l.budget_id, s.display_name AS budget_name, l.default_threshold
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_limit l
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_snapshot s ON s.budget_id = l.budget_id AND s.snapshot_time = l.snapshot_time
  WHERE l.scope_type = 'ALERT_CONFIGURATION_SCOPE_TYPE_PER_USER'
    AND l.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_ws AS (
  SELECT budget_id, workspace_id FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_workspace WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag AS (
  SELECT budget_id, tag_key, tag_value FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_tag WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag_keys AS (SELECT budget_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_key) AS n_keys FROM bud_tag GROUP BY budget_id),
bud_ids AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, run_as, tags_json, from_json(tags_json, 'map<string,string>') AS tags
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as, to_json(custom_tags) AS tags_json
    FROM system.billing.usage
    WHERE billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90)
      AND identity_metadata.run_as IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  )
),
bud_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT budget_id, run_as FROM (
    SELECT p.budget_id, i.run_as, COALESCE(k.n_keys, 0) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tag_key) AS n_matched
    FROM bud_per_user p
    CROSS JOIN bud_ids i
    LEFT JOIN bud_ws w ON w.budget_id = p.budget_id AND w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT budget_id FROM bud_ws) hw ON hw.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag_keys k ON k.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag t ON t.budget_id = p.budget_id AND try_element_at(i.tags, t.tag_key) = t.tag_value
    WHERE w.budget_id IS NOT NULL OR hw.budget_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.budget_id, i.run_as, i.workspace_id, i.tags_json, k.n_keys
  )
  WHERE n_matched = n_keys
),
bud_principal AS (
  SELECT principal_id, principal_type, run_as FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_principal WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_override AS (
  SELECT budget_id, principal_id, override_threshold FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_override WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_user_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, p.run_as, o.override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o JOIN bud_principal p ON p.principal_id = o.principal_id AND p.principal_type <> 'GROUP'
),
bud_group_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, m.run_as, MAX(o.override_threshold) AS override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_group_member g ON g.group_id = o.principal_id AND g.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
  JOIN bud_principal m ON m.principal_id = g.member_principal_id
  GROUP BY o.budget_id, m.run_as
),
user_budget AS (
  SELECT run_as, budget_name, budget_limit_usd, budget_limit_source FROM (
    SELECT s.run_as, p.budget_name,
      -- Within a budget the most permissive override wins (own or any group's); any override
      -- replaces the default. GREATEST skips NULLs. Across budgets the tightest limit wins.
      COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold) AS budget_limit_usd,
      CASE WHEN uo.override_threshold IS NULL AND gov.override_threshold IS NULL THEN 'Budget default'
           WHEN gov.override_threshold IS NULL OR uo.override_threshold >= gov.override_threshold THEN 'Own override'
           ELSE 'Group override' END AS budget_limit_source,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.run_as
        ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold), p.budget_name) AS rn
    FROM bud_scope s
    JOIN bud_per_user p ON p.budget_id = s.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_user_ovr uo ON uo.budget_id = s.budget_id AND uo.run_as = s.run_as
    LEFT JOIN bud_group_ovr gov ON gov.budget_id = s.budget_id AND gov.run_as = s.run_as
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
_base AS (
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    coalesce(b.bu, '(unmapped)') bu,
    CASE
      WHEN ae.initiated_by LIKE '%@%' THEN 'Human'
      ELSE 'Service'
    END user_type,
    ae.initiated_by,
    count(distinct ae.workspace_id) workspaces,
    count(distinct
      CASE
        WHEN ae.event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90) THEN ae.event_date
      END
    ) active_days_90d,
    count(
      CASE
        WHEN ae.event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90) THEN 1
      END
    ) subs_90d,
    min(ae.event_date) first_seen,
    max(ae.event_date) last_seen
  FROM
    system.access.assistant_events ae
      LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary b
        ON CAST(ae.workspace_id AS STRING) = b.workspace_id
  WHERE
    ae.event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN active_days_90d >= 30 THEN 'Power (30+ days)'
    WHEN active_days_90d >= 8 THEN 'Regular (8-29)'
    WHEN active_days_90d >= 2 THEN 'Occasional (2-7)'
    WHEN active_days_90d = 1 THEN 'Tried once'
    ELSE 'Inactive (90d)'
  END AS segment,
  CASE
    WHEN
      last_seen < date_sub(current_date(), 30)
      AND last_seen >= date_sub(current_date(), 60)
    THEN
      1
    ELSE 0
  END AS lapsed,
  CASE
    WHEN first_seen >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_new_30d,
  CASE
    WHEN active_days_90d >= 1 THEN active_days_90d
  END AS engaged_days,
  CASE
    WHEN active_days_90d >= 30 THEN 1
  END AS power_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN active_days_90d = 1 THEN 1
  END AS tried_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN
      workspaces > 1
      AND active_days_90d >= 1
    THEN
      1
  END AS multi_ws_flag
  ,
  CASE WHEN first_seen >= date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_monthly
  ,
  CASE WHEN last_seen >= date_trunc('MONTH', add_months(current_date(), -1)) AND last_seen < date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lapsed_monthly
FROM
  base
)
SELECT _base.*,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN COALESCE(ub.budget_name, 'No per-user budget')
       WHEN bs.status = 'NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN 'N/A: budgets not set up'
       WHEN bs.status IS NULL THEN 'N/A: budget job has not run'
       ELSE 'N/A: budget job failed' END AS budget_name,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_usd END AS budget_limit_usd,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_source END AS budget_limit_source
FROM _base CROSS JOIN bud_status bs LEFT JOIN user_budget ub ON ub.run_as = _base.`initiated_by`

    LEFT JOIN bud_tag_keys k ON k.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag t ON t.budget_id = p.budget_id AND try_element_at(i.tags, t.tag_key) = t.tag_value
    WHERE w.budget_id IS NOT NULL OR hw.budget_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.budget_id, i.run_as, i.workspace_id, i.tags_json, k.n_keys
  )
  WHERE n_matched = n_keys
),
bud_principal AS (
  SELECT principal_id, principal_type, run_as FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_principal WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_override AS (
  SELECT budget_id, principal_id, override_threshold FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_override WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_user_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, p.run_as, o.override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o JOIN bud_principal p ON p.principal_id = o.principal_id AND p.principal_type <> 'GROUP'
),
bud_group_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, m.run_as, MAX(o.override_threshold) AS override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_group_member g ON g.group_id = o.principal_id AND g.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
  JOIN bud_principal m ON m.principal_id = g.member_principal_id
  GROUP BY o.budget_id, m.run_as
),
user_budget AS (
  SELECT run_as, budget_name, budget_limit_usd, budget_limit_source FROM (
    SELECT s.run_as, p.budget_name,
      -- Within a budget the most permissive override wins (own or any group's); any override
      -- replaces the default. GREATEST skips NULLs. Across budgets the tightest limit wins.
      COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold) AS budget_limit_usd,
      CASE WHEN uo.override_threshold IS NULL AND gov.override_threshold IS NULL THEN 'Budget default'
           WHEN gov.override_threshold IS NULL OR uo.override_threshold >= gov.override_threshold THEN 'Own override'
           ELSE 'Group override' END AS budget_limit_source,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.run_as
        ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold), p.budget_name) AS rn
    FROM bud_scope s
    JOIN bud_per_user p ON p.budget_id = s.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_user_ovr uo ON uo.budget_id = s.budget_id AND uo.run_as = s.run_as
    LEFT JOIN bud_group_ovr gov ON gov.budget_id = s.budget_id AND gov.run_as = s.run_as
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
_base AS (
SELECT
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_one_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_one_cost,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_agents_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_agents_cost,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_paid_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_paid_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  u.identity_metadata.run_as
ORDER BY
  genie_code_paid_cost DESC
)
SELECT _base.*,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN COALESCE(ub.budget_name, 'No per-user budget')
       WHEN bs.status = 'NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN 'N/A: budgets not set up'
       WHEN bs.status IS NULL THEN 'N/A: budget job has not run'
       ELSE 'N/A: budget job failed' END AS budget_name,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_usd END AS budget_limit_usd,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_source END AS budget_limit_source
FROM _base CROSS JOIN bud_status bs LEFT JOIN user_budget ub ON ub.run_as = _base.`user`

WITH
-- budget columns: per-user AI Gateway budget for each identity (billing run_as).
-- Budget tables are read at the snapshot of the budget job's latest run. If that run didn't
-- succeed (or never ran) the budget columns show an 'N/A: ...' placeholder instead.
bud_status AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(status, run_time) AS status, MAX_BY(snapshot_time, run_time) AS ts
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_job_status
),
bud_ts AS (SELECT ts FROM bud_status),
bud_per_user AS (
  SELECT l.budget_id, s.display_name AS budget_name, l.default_threshold
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_limit l
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_snapshot s ON s.budget_id = l.budget_id AND s.snapshot_time = l.snapshot_time
  WHERE l.scope_type = 'ALERT_CONFIGURATION_SCOPE_TYPE_PER_USER'
    AND l.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_ws AS (
  SELECT budget_id, workspace_id FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_workspace WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag AS (
  SELECT budget_id, tag_key, tag_value FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_tag WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag_keys AS (SELECT budget_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_key) AS n_keys FROM bud_tag GROUP BY budget_id),
bud_ids AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, run_as, tags_json, from_json(tags_json, 'map<string,string>') AS tags
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as, to_json(custom_tags) AS tags_json
    FROM system.billing.usage
    WHERE billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90)
      AND identity_metadata.run_as IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  )
),
bud_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT budget_id, run_as FROM (
    SELECT p.budget_id, i.run_as, COALESCE(k.n_keys, 0) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tag_key) AS n_matched
    FROM bud_per_user p
    CROSS JOIN bud_ids i
    LEFT JOIN bud_ws w ON w.budget_id = p.budget_id AND w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT budget_id FROM bud_ws) hw ON hw.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag_keys k ON k.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag t ON t.budget_id = p.budget_id AND try_element_at(i.tags, t.tag_key) = t.tag_value
    WHERE w.budget_id IS NOT NULL OR hw.budget_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.budget_id, i.run_as, i.workspace_id, i.tags_json, k.n_keys
  )
  WHERE n_matched = n_keys
),
bud_principal AS (
  SELECT principal_id, principal_type, run_as FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_principal WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_override AS (
  SELECT budget_id, principal_id, override_threshold FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_override WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_user_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, p.run_as, o.override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o JOIN bud_principal p ON p.principal_id = o.principal_id AND p.principal_type <> 'GROUP'
),
bud_group_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, m.run_as, MAX(o.override_threshold) AS override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_group_member g ON g.group_id = o.principal_id AND g.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
  JOIN bud_principal m ON m.principal_id = g.member_principal_id
  GROUP BY o.budget_id, m.run_as
),
user_budget AS (
  SELECT run_as, budget_name, budget_limit_usd, budget_limit_source FROM (
    SELECT s.run_as, p.budget_name,
      -- Within a budget the most permissive override wins (own or any group's); any override
      -- replaces the default. GREATEST skips NULLs. Across budgets the tightest limit wins.
      COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold) AS budget_limit_usd,
      CASE WHEN uo.override_threshold IS NULL AND gov.override_threshold IS NULL THEN 'Budget default'
           WHEN gov.override_threshold IS NULL OR uo.override_threshold >= gov.override_threshold THEN 'Own override'
           ELSE 'Group override' END AS budget_limit_source,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.run_as
        ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold), p.budget_name) AS rn
    FROM bud_scope s
    JOIN bud_per_user p ON p.budget_id = s.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_user_ovr uo ON uo.budget_id = s.budget_id AND uo.run_as = s.run_as
    LEFT JOIN bud_group_ovr gov ON gov.budget_id = s.budget_id AND gov.run_as = s.run_as
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
_base AS (
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id AS agent_id,
  COALESCE(gs.genie_space_name, u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id, '(unmatched)') AS genie_space_name,
  COALESCE(gs.sql_warehouse_name, '(unknown warehouse)') AS sql_warehouse_name,
  COALESCE(gs.warehouse_application, '(untagged)')       AS warehouse_application,
  u.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
  COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
  COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
  CASE WHEN u.identity_metadata.run_as LIKE '%@%' THEN 'Human' ELSE 'Service' END AS user_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name  = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS free_dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS paid_dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default ELSE 0 END) AS cost
FROM system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.dim_genie_space gs
    ON gs.genie_space_id = u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id
  LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON CAST(u.workspace_id AS BIGINT) = ws.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
    AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time

WITH
-- budget columns: per-user AI Gateway budget for each identity (billing run_as).
-- Budget tables are read at the snapshot of the budget job's latest run. If that run didn't
-- succeed (or never ran) the budget columns show an 'N/A: ...' placeholder instead.
bud_status AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(status, run_time) AS status, MAX_BY(snapshot_time, run_time) AS ts
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_job_status
),
bud_ts AS (SELECT ts FROM bud_status),
bud_per_user AS (
  SELECT l.budget_id, s.display_name AS budget_name, l.default_threshold
  FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_limit l
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_snapshot s ON s.budget_id = l.budget_id AND s.snapshot_time = l.snapshot_time
  WHERE l.scope_type = 'ALERT_CONFIGURATION_SCOPE_TYPE_PER_USER'
    AND l.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_ws AS (
  SELECT budget_id, workspace_id FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_workspace WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag AS (
  SELECT budget_id, tag_key, tag_value FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_tag WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_tag_keys AS (SELECT budget_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_key) AS n_keys FROM bud_tag GROUP BY budget_id),
bud_ids AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, run_as, tags_json, from_json(tags_json, 'map<string,string>') AS tags
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as, to_json(custom_tags) AS tags_json
    FROM system.billing.usage
    WHERE billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90)
      AND identity_metadata.run_as IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  )
),
bud_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT budget_id, run_as FROM (
    SELECT p.budget_id, i.run_as, COALESCE(k.n_keys, 0) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tag_key) AS n_matched
    FROM bud_per_user p
    CROSS JOIN bud_ids i
    LEFT JOIN bud_ws w ON w.budget_id = p.budget_id AND w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT budget_id FROM bud_ws) hw ON hw.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag_keys k ON k.budget_id = p.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_tag t ON t.budget_id = p.budget_id AND try_element_at(i.tags, t.tag_key) = t.tag_value
    WHERE w.budget_id IS NOT NULL OR hw.budget_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.budget_id, i.run_as, i.workspace_id, i.tags_json, k.n_keys
  )
  WHERE n_matched = n_keys
),
bud_principal AS (
  SELECT principal_id, principal_type, run_as FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_principal WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_override AS (
  SELECT budget_id, principal_id, override_threshold FROM `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_override WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
),
bud_user_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, p.run_as, o.override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o JOIN bud_principal p ON p.principal_id = o.principal_id AND p.principal_type <> 'GROUP'
),
bud_group_ovr AS (
  SELECT o.budget_id, m.run_as, MAX(o.override_threshold) AS override_threshold
  FROM bud_override o
  JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.budget_group_member g ON g.group_id = o.principal_id AND g.snapshot_time = (SELECT ts FROM bud_ts)
  JOIN bud_principal m ON m.principal_id = g.member_principal_id
  GROUP BY o.budget_id, m.run_as
),
user_budget AS (
  SELECT run_as, budget_name, budget_limit_usd, budget_limit_source FROM (
    SELECT s.run_as, p.budget_name,
      -- Within a budget the most permissive override wins (own or any group's); any override
      -- replaces the default. GREATEST skips NULLs. Across budgets the tightest limit wins.
      COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold) AS budget_limit_usd,
      CASE WHEN uo.override_threshold IS NULL AND gov.override_threshold IS NULL THEN 'Budget default'
           WHEN gov.override_threshold IS NULL OR uo.override_threshold >= gov.override_threshold THEN 'Own override'
           ELSE 'Group override' END AS budget_limit_source,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.run_as
        ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(uo.override_threshold, gov.override_threshold), p.default_threshold), p.budget_name) AS rn
    FROM bud_scope s
    JOIN bud_per_user p ON p.budget_id = s.budget_id
    LEFT JOIN bud_user_ovr uo ON uo.budget_id = s.budget_id AND uo.run_as = s.run_as
    LEFT JOIN bud_group_ovr gov ON gov.budget_id = s.budget_id AND gov.run_as = s.run_as
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
_base AS (
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(ws.workspace_name, CONCAT('(unmapped: ', CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING), ')')) AS workspace_name,
  COALESCE(ws.bu, '(unmapped)')          AS bu,
  COALESCE(ws.environment, '(unmapped)') AS environment,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
  CASE WHEN u.identity_metadata.run_as LIKE '%@%' THEN 'Human' ELSE 'Service' END AS user_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name  = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS free_dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS paid_dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default ELSE 0 END) AS cost
FROM system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN `__CATALOG__`.`__SCHEMA__`.workspace_summary ws
    ON CAST(u.workspace_id AS BIGINT) = ws.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
    AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
    AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
)
SELECT _base.*,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN COALESCE(ub.budget_name, 'No per-user budget')
       WHEN bs.status = 'NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN 'N/A: budgets not set up'
       WHEN bs.status IS NULL THEN 'N/A: budget job has not run'
       ELSE 'N/A: budget job failed' END AS budget_name,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_usd END AS budget_limit_usd,
  CASE WHEN bs.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN ub.budget_limit_source END AS budget_limit_source
FROM _base CROSS JOIN bud_status bs LEFT JOIN user_budget ub ON ub.run_as = _base.`user`

WITH activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_identity.email AS user_name, event_date
  FROM system.access.audit
  WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'
    AND user_identity.email IS NOT NULL
    AND user_identity.email <> 'System-User'
    AND event_date BETWEEN date_sub(:date_range.min, 29) AND :date_range.max
),
days AS (
  SELECT explode(sequence(:date_range.min, :date_range.max, interval 1 day)) AS d
),
rollup AS (
  SELECT days.d AS event_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.event_date BETWEEN date_sub(days.d, 6)  AND days.d THEN a.user_name END) AS wau,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.event_date BETWEEN date_sub(days.d, 29) AND days.d THEN a.user_name END) AS mau
  FROM days LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.event_date BETWEEN date_sub(days.d, 29) AND days.d
  GROUP BY days.d
)
SELECT event_date, 'WAU (rolling 7-day)'  AS metric, wau AS users FROM rollup
UNION ALL
SELECT event_date, 'MAU (rolling 30-day)' AS metric, mau AS users FROM rollup
ORDER BY event_date, metric

- **Active users**: distinct `user_identity.email` values that made at least one Genie API call in the date window. System-User is excluded.

- **Successful messages**: message-create events where `response.status_code < 400`.

lines:
### Definitions
- **Message latency**: polling-span proxy: time from first to last polling call for a message_id (self-join on the `genieGet…` / `getConversationMessage` polling actions). System tables expose no direct Genie response duration today.
- **P50 / P95 / P99**: computed over messages that completed within 600s; **messages >600s (long-running / stuck / non-response) are EXCLUDED from the percentiles** and surfaced separately as the long-running rate.
- **Long-running >600s (rate)**: share of messages whose poll-span exceeded 600s.
- **Successful / Errored messages**: message-create events with `response.status_code < 400` / `>= 400`.
- **Errors per agent by type**: errored message-create events, split by class. **429** = a platform guardrail (the old per-agent QPM cap was removed with Genie PayGo, so a 429 today signals a different limit: LLM capacity / workspace concurrency / token budget); **4xx** = client; **5xx** = server.
- **Avg messages / conversation**: mean message-create events per conversation in the window.
